# Filter rows for the specified seasons
seasons_of_interest = [1977, 1978, 1989]
filtered_df = df[df['season'].isin(seasons_of_interest)]

# Check each condition for each row
condition_points = filtered_df['points'] > 26
condition_games = filtered_df['games'] < 18
condition_losses = filtered_df['losses'] == 13

# Combine conditions: all three must be true for at least one row
combined_condition = condition_points & condition_games & condition_losses

# Determine if any row satisfies all conditions
answer = combined_condition.any()
